title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.65
summary: Repair the Docker Compose V1 updater crash and detect the live go2rtc API prefix, retaining faster 25-camera bootstrap.
changes: Bundle Docker Compose V2 within the updater to prevent legacy ContainerConfig errors
Provide a safe host-side recovery for existing Compose V1 updater installations
Detect go2rtc root API when the configured prefixed API returns 404 and cache it for media reads
Keep four bounded parallel camera starts and 250ms ingest startup staggering
Preserve existing recording, motion, HLS and camera settings
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.65
description: Compose V2 updater, host-side updater rescue before in-app upgrade, and automatic go2rtc root API fallback.
releaseNotes: Compatible from 2.20.32. Existing broken Compose V1 updaters MUST first run scripts/recover-updater-compose-v2.sh from the host before using Update Center. Preserves .env, recordings, cameras and database. Contains v2.20.64 faster start defaults.
